snippet.title: CATO: Buttered Cat Release Trailer | Nintendo Switch/PlayStation®5
snippet.description:
A cat and a piece of buttered toast plan their great escape in this tricky puzzle-filled adventure!
Coming to the Nintendo Switch and PS5® on May 1, 2025! https://playism.com/game/cato/

When dropped, cats always fall on their feet, and buttered toast always falls buttered side down. But when a piece of buttered toast is attached to the back of a cat, a paradox is created, giving birth to a floating, perpetually spinning source of infinite energy!

In this game inspired by the famous buttered cat paradox that went viral on the internet, the protagonists of "cat" and "buttered toast" cooperate to escape from a labyrinth of stages filled with all sorts of puzzles.

In addition to over 140 main stages and over 60 optional stages, CATO: Buttered Cat also has a wide variety of hidden rooms, boss fights, and mini games. Collect cute costumes for your cat and toast, or even play co-op with a friend!

Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cato-buttered-cat-switch/
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013603

Developer: Team Woll
Publisher: PLAYISM
